calculate_bbox_iou: calculate the intersection over union between two sets of bounding boxes using numpy arrays
calculate_bbox_iof: calculate the intersection over foreground between two sets of bounding boxes using numpy arrays
compute_overlap_matrix: compute an overlap matrix of shape (n, k) for all pairs of bounding boxes
